newsitem.title: GERMANY: German clinic silent on cardiologists' Moscow trip.
newsitem.headline: German clinic silent on cardiologists' Moscow trip.

text.p: The German heart clinic that is sending two top cardiologists to Moscow to advise Russian doctors on President Boris Yeltsin's planned heart operation declined on Monday to say when they were due to leave.

A spokesman for the Medical Technical College in Hanover told Reuters that comments by Russian heart surgeon Renat Akchurin that the operation could be delayed to reduce medical dangers "seem to be appropriate".
But he declined to say any more about plans by cardiologists Axel Haverich and Thorsten Wahlers to travel to Moscow.
Akchurin had said on Sunday that the operation, originally planned for September, could be delayed for up to two months to take account of Yeltsin's condition.
Chancellor Helmut Kohl promised Yeltsin while on a visit to Moscow earlier this month that he would send German heart doctors to join the Russian president's medical team of experts.
